workUnit: SmartAIHub R5 canonical worker process restart and useful-work recovery slice

database.port: ephemeral loopback port allocated by the guarded runner
database.schemaBootstrap: drizzle.mini-app-baseline.config.ts current-schema migration set, applied only to this runner-created cluster

phases: producer created canonical development run and SPEC worker_jobs/outbox entry, then exited
fresh worker process completed SPEC and persisted progress
fresh worker process injected a retryable TEST failure and persisted retry_scheduled state
recovery process made the retry eligible and published its canonical outbox intent, then exited
fresh worker process resumed TEST at attempt 2 and persisted useful artifacts and completion
final process reloaded the run and job rows, confirmed both stages complete and dispatch consumed
verification.provider: synthetic deterministic executor; no external provider

focusedRegression.command: pnpm --filter @smartspec/web exec vitest run server/services/miniAppFactoryStageWorker.test.ts server/services/miniAppFactoryDurableState.test.ts server/jobs/nodeWorkerScheduling.test.ts server/jobs/nodeWorkerRecoveryPolicy.test.ts server/jobs/nodeWorkerShutdown.test.ts

reviewLenses: The exported initializer takes no request or client-supplied identity input.
Executor loading remains server-owned and retains the production trusted Runner adapter as the default composition.
Synthetic execution is enabled only in the isolated local acceptance script.
The initializer reuses the existing idempotent module-load guard and does not create a second worker registry.
Worker discovery, claim, attempts, settlements, and dispatch continue through canonical worker_jobs/outbox.
Producer, worker, retry-recovery, resumed worker, and final verifier are separate Node processes.
Retry recovery preserves one logical job identity and resumes at attempt 2 rather than duplicating the stage result.
Useful progress and artifacts are reloaded from persisted development-run state after worker processes exit.
The disposable runner rejects inherited DATABASE_URL and binds PostgreSQL to loopback with synthetic data only.
SPEC-224 protected dispatch, production migrations, deployments, grants, and production ingress are not invoked.
limitations: This proves a canonical worker_jobs/outbox process-boundary retry and useful-work recovery slice, not SPEC-271 authoritative receipt acceptance.
The AutoTeam scheduled recovery path was not executed; its current-schema team_rooms/team_runs tables are absent from this disposable profile.
No stale-lease fencing race, active-process kill mid-execution, bounded no-progress scan, provider/capacity/dependency wait, or Task Control projection assertion was run.
Do not report full SPEC-277, SPEC-271, or T-01 through T-23 completion from this evidence.
